finalists.label: Periapical granuloma
finalists.why: It has the most specific and relevant evidence, including the description of the tissue yielded by curettage and the provisional diagnosis.

finalists.label: Dental abscess
finalists.why: It is supported by the provisional diagnosis of a periapical abscess, despite the lack of tenderness on percussion.

finalists.label: Dental caries
finalists.why: It is directly mentioned as a finding, but it does not fully explain the swelling and other symptoms.

frontier_selector.why: The description of the gelatinous, soft, mushy tissue from the curettage and the lack of strong evidence against it made Periapical granuloma the most likely diagnosis.
